request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"The Entrepreneurship Club is hosting Pitch Night, an evening where student founders present their ideas to a panel of alumni judges. It is open to students who are curious about starting something of their own, as well as those ready to share an idea. We are reaching out because refreshments for the audience would make a real difference. Students will be listening, asking questions and cheering on their peers, and having food and drink on hand would help them settle in, stay engaged and feel welcome. We would be glad to tell you more about the event and how your help could support the students who attend.","contains_instructions":false}
